jurisdiction: Government of India - Department of Consumer Affairs

rules.description: Every package must declare the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in Indian Rupees, clearly stating that it is inclusive of all taxes.
rules.error_message: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration is missing or fails to state 'incl. of all taxes'.

rules.description: The net quantity of the commodity contained in the package must be declared in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, m, cm, or Number/N).
rules.error_message: Net Quantity declaration is missing or uses non-standard non-metric units.

rules.rule_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported must be clearly indicated.
rules.error_message: Month and Year of Manufacture/Packing is missing or improperly formatted.

rules.rule_name: Name and Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rules.description: Every package must bear the name and complete postal address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
rules.error_message: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer name or address details are missing or incomplete.

rules.description: The package must contain the helpline phone number, email ID, and address for consumer grievance redressal.
rules.error_message: Consumer Care helpline number or email contact details are missing.

rules.rule_name: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
rules.description: The generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package must be clearly stated.
rules.error_message: Generic or common name of the commodity is missing.

rules.description: The country of origin of the commodity must be prominently declared on imported packages.
rules.error_message: Country of origin declaration is missing.

rules.description: Unit sale price (e.g., price per gram, per ml, per metre, per piece) should be declared on packages containing multi-unit or bulk items.
rules.error_message: Unit Sale Price (USP) declaration is missing or invalid format.

rules.rule_name: Expiry Date / Best Before Date Declaration
rules.description: Packages containing food, pharmaceuticals, or perishable commodities must declare Expiry Date or Best Before Date.
rules.error_message: Expiry Date or Best Before declaration is missing or invalid format.

rules.description: Commodities sold by size or dimensions (e.g. garments, textiles, electronic equipment) must state package dimensions or size in standard metric units.
rules.error_message: Package Dimensions / Size declaration is missing or unverified.

rules.rule_name: FSSAI Food Safety License Number Declaration
rules.description: Every packaged food commodity must display the 14-digit FSSAI license number and logo.
rules.error_message: FSSAI 14-digit license number declaration is missing or invalid format.

rules.rule_name: Batch or Lot / Code Number Declaration
rules.description: Every package must bear the code or batch number identifying the lot or consignment.
rules.error_message: Batch or Lot number declaration is missing.
